title: App for SOAR pairing with later ES releases is not established by the reviewed matrix
problem: The reviewed App for SOAR 8.7.0 matrix lists ES 8.7.0 and 8.6.1; it does not establish pairing with ES 8.7.1, 8.8 or 8.9.

audiences: Customers and documentation readers evaluating the stated decision
exclusions: No tenant rollout, entitlement, authorization or environment-specific approval is inferred.

impact.customerScenario: A reader plans an App for SOAR integration with a later ES release.
impact.consequence: Independent release numbers are insufficient to establish compatibility; unlisted does not mean explicitly unsupported.

confidence.rationale: Historical published observations are normalized without creating a new source review or numeric confidence score.

lifecycle.reason: No withdrawal, merge or supersession is recorded.

evidence.statement: The audit records the exact listed compatibility rows and leaves the later ES pairings unestablished.

documentRevision.qualification: No exact official-document revision or response-body digest was retained for this statement in the cited observation.
